name: methane_tank_evaporation
title: Evaporation of liquid methane in a tank
summary: Liquid methane at 500 kPa in a tank evaporates due to heat input (level drop of 30 mm per hour); the model computes the evaporated mass and the volumetric flow rate of the gas leaving a heater at 500 kPa and 275 K.

origin.course: Thermodynamique appliquée (ULiège, MECA0002), repetition session 1, exercise 3

verification.reference: EES stored solution (12 variables) of the source file, converted with --ees-units
verification.notes: All 12 original variables agree; largest deviation 2.6e-5 (vapour specific volume), both tools using the reference equation of state of methane. Same import as CoolSolve docs/ees_import.md §12 Example 3.
